title: Facial Lipoatrophy Correction Experience With SCULPTRA ("FACES" Study)
brief_summary: 5 year, open-label study to evaluate safety of SCULPTRA on the signs of lipoatrophy of the face in at least 100 evaluable subjects with human immunodeficiency virus.
study_population: Subjects seropositive for human immunodeficiency virus who in the investigator's judgment, have a high probability of 5 year survival and compliance with the study visit schedule, and are initiating SCULPTRA treatments.
